data.body:
`main()` still performs two independent `store.list_json(...)` calls — one for `events/pr-{number}/finding_observed/` and one for `events/pr-{number}/finding_verdict/` — and each one independently invokes `TelemetryStore._load_tree()`, which does its own ref + commit + recursive-tree round trip to the GitHub API. There is no caching/sharing of the tree between the two calls, so this read path now costs twice as many GitHub API requests as before on every invocation (generation-time call without `--decisions-output`, and the publish-time call from `post_ai_review.sh`). The new test `test_cli_writes_both_views_from_one_verdict_read` even asserts `store.list_json.call_count == 2`, confirming the duplication is unaddressed.

Fix: fetch the tree once and derive both prefix listings from it, e.g. add a `TelemetryStore` method that lists multiple prefixes against a single `_load_tree()` call, or cache/reuse the loaded `GitTree` for the duration of one process invocation.
